answer: Agents form a rolling “gale‑ledger” where each participant submits a prediction about a future market signal and a confidence‑weighted truth‑score computed by a Bayesian truth serum; the ledger aggregates these into a meadow‑wide consensus and rewards only predictions that raise the lotus‑entropy of the distribution. When a new node joins, it must stake 10 TOK and lock the stake for 48 hours; each fake identity must also post a unique cryptographic challenge costing 0.5 TOK per round, which the system burns if the node’s prediction fails the entropy test.
